title: Service Contracts: Suspension, Reinstatement, Termination for Default and Expiry
content:
This page covers the states an AHL Service Contract can pass into after it has become active: suspension, reinstatement, termination by the line for default, and expiry at the end of the term.

## Suspension

A contract is suspended on either of two grounds:

- **overdue dead freight** — a shortfall assessment on the contract is still unpaid once the tier's overdue period, in calendar days, has run beyond that assessment's payment due date;
- **credit hold** — the customer's credit standing on its record changes to credit hold.

Suspension for overdue dead freight is available only when an assessment on the contract remains unpaid after the date arrived at by adding the overdue period to its payment due date. Whether that is so is read from the contract account: the assessments booked, their dates, and the shortfall balance still owed.

While suspended, a contract accepts no new contract bookings. Bookings already confirmed under it still sail and are still credited to it.

## Reinstatement

A suspended contract is reinstated, and becomes active again, once every overdue shortfall on it has been paid and any credit hold on the customer has been lifted.

## Termination for default

When a contract has stayed suspended without interruption for the tier's number of calendar days, the line may terminate it for default. Every shortfall still outstanding remains payable after the termination.

## Expiry

An active contract that reaches its expiry date expires. The dead freight and volume rebate due for the term are then dealt with under the term-end provisions for shortfall and for rebate.

## Periods by tier

| Tier | Overdue period after the payment due date (calendar days) | Continuous suspension after which the line may terminate (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 15 | 30 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 15 | 30 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 30 | 45 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 30 | 60 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 45 | 60 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 60 | 90 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation on the records | Position |
|---|---|
| Starter contract; an assessment due on 31 March is still unpaid on 16 April | past 31 March plus 15 days; ground for suspension exists |
| Regional Account contract; an assessment due on 10 May is still unpaid on 10 June | past 10 May plus 30 days; ground for suspension exists |
| Key Account contract; every assessment paid, but the customer's credit standing has become credit hold | ground for suspension exists |
| Suspended contract; the overdue assessment is paid and the customer was never on credit hold | reinstated to active |
| Global Account contract suspended without interruption for 60 calendar days | the line may terminate it for default; any unpaid shortfall stays owed |
| Suspended contract; a booking confirmed before the suspension departs | it sails and its volume is credited |
